sources.title: Broncos re-sign RB JK Dobbins to a two-year deal
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos have re-signed running back JK Dobbins to a two-year deal. The Broncos missed out on Kenneth Walker and Travis Etienne, but brought back Dobbins, who was a top rusher in the league before suffering a season-ending foot injury.
